consistency_internal.explantion: Both Response a and Response b exhibit the same critical shortcomings: they conflate distinct therapeutic frameworks (REBT and CBT) without clear differentiation, present the link between rigid attitudes and erroneous beliefs as an unquestioned consensus, and make causal claims without proper attribution. The nature and impact of these errors are equivalent in both answers, leaving no clear advantage for either response in terms of internal consistency.
